name: AL Language TryWrite Allowed
brief: Writes inside a TryFunction on a server where DisableWriteInsideTryFunctions is off (BC online).
description: Measured on a BC SaaS sandbox, where the server setting DisableWriteInsideTryFunctions is off. The CI containers keep the setting at its default (writes denied), so ci.yml does not build this app; the denied case is pinned in tests/al-language/errors/lt-r7143-try-write/. Holds an install codeunit with the shape of al-runner issue 7143 (OnInstallAppPerDatabase writes through a TryFunction).
